title: fagara chiloperone
intro: Fagara chiloperone, commonly known as Chilean pepper tree, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. The health benefits of Fagara chiloperone include its use in traditional medicine for treating fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Fagara chiloperone include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
